caseNameFull: ATCHISON, TOPEKA & SANTA FE RAILWAY CO. v. DIXIE CARRIERS, INC.
attorneys: Robert H. Bierma, Richard J. Murphy and Harvey Huston for the Atchison; Topeka & Santa Fe Railway Co. et al., appellants in No. 60., Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Hansen, Robert W. Ginnane and H. Neil Garson for the United States, appellant in No. 61, and the Interstate Commerce Commission, appellant in No. 62., Donald Macleay, Harry C. Ames, Harry C. Ames, Jr., Nuel D. Belnap, T. S. opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Upon the suggestion of mootness the judgment of the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas is vacated and the case is remanded with directions to dismiss the complaint.
